text:
Predicates:
WorkLibrary(x) ::: x works in the library.
FromCompSciDept(x) ::: x is from the computer science department.
PartTimeUni(x) ::: x has a part-time job offered by the university.
TakeDatabaseCourse(x) ::: x takes the database course.
InstructedBy(x, y) ::: x is instructed by y.
WorkLab(x) ::: x works in the lab.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
Premises:
¬∀x (Student(x) ∧ WorkLibrary(x) → FromCompSciDept(x)) ::: No students who work in the library are from the computer science department.
∀x (Student(x) ∧ PartTimeUni(x) → WorkLibrary(x)) ::: All students who have part-time jobs offered by the university are students who work in the library.
∀x (Student(x) ∧ TakeDatabaseCourse(x) → FromCompSciDept(x)) ::: All students who take the database course are from the computer science department.
∀x (Student(x) ∧ InstructedBy(x, david) → TakeDatabaseCourse(x)) ::: All students instructed by professor David are taking the database course.
∀x (Student(x) ∧ WorkLab(x) → InstructedBy(x, david)) ::: All students working in the lab are instructed by professor David.
WorkLab(james) ∧ Student(james) ::: James is a student working in the lab.
¬(PartTimeUni(jack) ∨ WorkLab(jack)) ::: Jack neither has a part-time job offered by the university nor works in the lab.
Conclusion:
¬PartTimeUni(james) ::: James does not have a part-time job offered by the university.
